<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Work items in lanes. Each lane has a title, a count and its cards; a card has a title, an optional tag and the
  person it belongs to. Axes: card (simple, detail: tag and person), cols (2, 3), tone, density. Moving a card
  between lanes is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Lane, BoardCard } from "./kanban-board.types";

export type KanbanBoardProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lanes: Lane[];
  empty?: string;
  cards: BoardCard[];
  countLabel: string;
  card?: "simple" | "detail";
  cols?: "2" | "3";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import Pill from "../components/pill.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lanes,
  empty = "",
  cards,
  countLabel,
  card = "detail",
  cols = "3",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<KanbanBoardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((lanes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="kanban" :title="empty" />
    <Grid
      v-else
      :cols="(((cols as string) === '2') ? '1-2' : '1-3')"
      class="items-start gap-4"
      data-testid="lanes"
    >
      <Stack
        v-for="lane in lanes"
        :key="lane.id"
        gap="4"
        align="stretch"
        class="rounded bg-muted p-4"
        data-testid="lane"
      >
        <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
          <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
            {{ lane.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(countLabel, (cards.filter((i) => !lane.key || i["lane"] === lane.key)?.length ?? 0)) }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          <ListItem v-for="c in cards.filter((i) => !lane.key || i['lane'] === lane.key)" :key="c.id"
            :class="cn(
              'flex flex-col rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border',
              (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'gap-2 p-2' : 'gap-2 p-4')
            )"
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ c.title }}
            </Text>
            <Group v-if="((card as string) === 'detail')" gap="2" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
              <Pill tone="blue" icon="tag">
                {{ c.tag }}
              </Pill>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ c.who }}
              </Text>
            </Group>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
